Package io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.themecreator

package io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.themecreator
Standalone authoring workbench for the same theme format used by Minecraft.

Follow an edit through ThemeCreator, the undoable ThemeDraft, and the shared ThemeDefinition resolver. The window owns selection and navigation; the draft owns only authoring data and history. Palette changes and scoped property changes therefore use one validation and inheritance model.

PreviewAtlas decodes captured menu images off the Swing event-dispatch thread, then paints and selects their semantic masks on that thread. It provides no independent Minecraft menu implementation. ThemeFiles serializes a validated proposal to a temporary sibling file before replacement; the window records a save only after that operation succeeds.

To add a color role, update the shared role catalog and native captures rather than adding a second hard-coded color table here. For user-facing instructions, see the Theme Creator README and the Themes guide in the main Javadocs.
